title: The FF normalization batch three (census 946)

banner.title: The FF normalization batch three - the FF book closer, the last 54 of 185 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission
banner.provenance: The FF normalization - the per-book schema pass concludes for the Fiend Folio (the R879 normalizer doctrine, the R1009-R1014 MM1 arc, R1016 the OA book close, R1017-R1020 the MM2 arc closed, R1021 the letters a-g, R1022 the letters h-r): the last 54 sparse FF defs (the letters s-z) rewritten to the canonical FIELD_ORDER emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; the FF book closes COMPLETE on both axes - 185 of 185 canonical; all 378 patches are anchored sentinel inserts under the single-line anchor doctrine (the R1021 aarakocra lesson); no reorders, no comma sites, no pin repairs - the FF book carries no fragment grids; the loader reads the sentinels under the R879 uniform coercer doctrine already live on the 787 normalized MM1, MM2 and OA defs

audit_comment: THE FF NORMALIZATION, THE BOOK CLOSER - the letters s-z, the last 54 of 185 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; the FF book closes COMPLETE; every patch an anchored sentinel insert.
include_after: #include "rules/ff/normalization_batch2.h"  // R1022: the FF normalization batch two

consts.name: fq3Round
consts.comment: the FF normalization batch three - the letters s-z, the FF book closer, 54 of 185

consts.name: fq3DefsNormalized
consts.comment: the FF defs rewritten to full-field canonical form this batch - the letters s-z

consts.name: fq3FfTotal
consts.comment: the FF def census - unchanged by the batch

consts.name: fq3FfNormalizedAfter
consts.comment: the FF defs carrying the full-field emission after this batch - the FF book complete

consts.name: fq3FfRemaining
consts.comment: the FF defs still sparse after this batch - NONE, the book closed

consts.name: fq3SchemaKeys
consts.comment: the canonical FIELD_ORDER length - every FF def emitted with all 57 keys

consts.name: fq3InsSites
consts.comment: the anchored insert sites - 1458 inserted lines, all sentinel fields

consts.name: fq3CommaSites
consts.comment: the trailing-comma whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, every text field already carried the Lua-optional comma

consts.name: fq3ReorderDefs
consts.comment: the defs needing whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, the fields already in canonical FIELD_ORDER

consts.name: fq3PatchEntries
consts.comment: the file patches this round - 378 monster windows, all anchored sentinel inserts

bools.name: fq3NormalizerCensusLive
bools.comment: the landed normalize_registry.py reads its full 1338-def census - the registry floor live

bools.name: fq3FullFieldEmission
bools.comment: every rewritten def carries all 57 keys - string sentinel n/a, integer sentinel -1, saveAsBonus the loader zero default

bools.name: fq3InsertOnly
bools.comment: zero whole-line rewrites, zero deletes - every patch an anchored insert, the single-line anchor doctrine (the R1021 aarakocra lesson held, the second engine pass simulated in full pre-handoff)

bools.name: fq3NoClassedDefs
bools.comment: no classed defs in the letters s-z - zero saveAs keys, the R155 contract untouched
